ivy (SRE): FYI: we're running a short control-plane path validation drill Fri 2026-10-01 03:00-03:20 UTC. Intention: exercise AZ route failover + KV cache rewarm. Expect brief 503 spikes; data plane should be unaffected.

lee (EngRuntime): Plan: flip route preference in us-east-1 for 7 minutes, then revert. Pre-warm KV caches 25 reqs/model per host 15m prior. Script live in runbook.

rachel (ProdOps): I'll publish a status page note and email enterprise contacts 2h ahead. Template: one-line impact, ETA, mitigation.

omar (Oncall): Abort criteria: 5xx >12% OR p95 +200ms for 3m. Abort key held by omar + lee. I'll monitor dash `cp-path-1864000001`.

alerts-bot: Reminder scheduled: channel #ops-validate-1864000001 will be created 10m prior and subscribe #eng-sre and #support.

lee (EngRuntime): Post-checks: synthetic burst 50 rps for 3m, token sampling for quality, and logs pinned to postmortem.

ivy (SRE): Support: please prepare canned replies for tickets (short ETA + note that this is planned drill).

rachel (ProdOps): Done. Also adding FAQ blurb: "Why now?" -> "to reduce blast radius in real failovers".

omar (Oncall): All set. Will abort and notify exec if thresholds exceeded.

ivy (SRE): Thanks. Keep comms clipped during the window and report any anomalies in #ops-validate-1864000001.
